source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 3 (ISL A3) · lesson 25. Rewritten for children from Dr. Hassan's lesson; facts and references kept.

learn.en: Jaʿfar was ʿAlī's older brother and another cousin of the Prophet ﷺ. Al-ʿAbbās looked after him during the famine. He was one of the earliest Muslims.
learn.title: Who was Jaʿfar?

learn.en: The Prophet ﷺ told him: “You look like me and you act like me.” (Bukhari 2699)
learn.title: Like the Prophet ﷺ

learn.en: To escape the bullies of Makkah, Jaʿfar and other Muslims travelled to Abyssinia (al-Ḥabashah).
learn.title: Journey to Abyssinia

learn.en: At the battle of Muʾtah, Jaʿfar bravely carried the flag and became a martyr. (Bukhari 4261)
learn.title: Brave at Muʾtah

learn.en: He is called Dhul-Janāḥayn — “the one with two wings” — wings he flies with in Paradise. (Bukhari 3709)
learn.title: Two wings in Paradise

quiz.en: What did the Prophet ﷺ say to Jaʿfar?
opts: You look like me and act like me

quiz.en: True or false? Jaʿfar travelled to Abyssinia.
True or false? Jaʿfar was ʿAlī's older brother.

think.q: Jaʿfar's character was like the Prophet's ﷺ. Which good habit of the Prophet ﷺ would you like to copy?
think.a: Smiling, honesty, kindness to children and animals — pick one and practise it this week!

parents.summary: Jaʿfar, ʿAlī's brother, looked and acted like the Prophet ﷺ, migrated to Abyssinia, was brave at Muʾtah, and is honoured as “the one with two wings” in Paradise.
parents.tip: Ask your child to draw Jaʿfar's two wings in Paradise and tell the story.
